description: A two-question trivia round then a final score summary — the mutable question-area container ("q_area") is resent WHOLE three times (two questions, one summary) with a completely different child set each time (never an append), the root wrapper is delivered exactly once and never resent, and the score updates via data-only reacts between rounds (the GH #307 same-surface RESUME discipline the shelf’s only other lifecycle exemplar, kpi-panel-lifecycle, never exercises — that one only ever appends).
name: trivia-round-resume
promptText: Run a 2-question trivia round: show one question with answer buttons, update the score after each pick, load the next question, then show a final score summary — without breaking anything as it moves through each step.
